text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the Takarazuka Kinen. Meisho Doto, stationed right behind T.M. Opera O, assumes her role as Opera O's second-in-command.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Half a year earlier, when Admire Vega was forced to drop out, T.M. Opera O had spoken of having no choice but to wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In truth, what she was waiting for was Meisho Doto's awakening. The time has come for Doto to display her race-readiness through her running.
